mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS review_id, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.review_id = r.id ) AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.review_id = r.id ) AS comment_count, ( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.review_id = r.id ) * 3 + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.review_id = r.id ) * 2 + GREATEST(0, #{windowDays} - TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, r.created_at, NOW())) ) AS score, #{windowDays} AS window_days, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM reviews r WHERE r.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowDays} DAY) ORDER BY score DESC, r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.insert:
